text:
Maya: PSA: Whoever keeps microwaving fish in the kitchen, we can smell it across the office :nauseated_face:
Aj: guilty? never :eyes:
Maya: Aj. do not. We officially named the phenomenon 'the Fish Fog' yesterday.
Keelin: The kitchen rules are simple: 1) label your food, 2) use the labeled shelf, 3) ventilate after microwaving.
Isla: we should crown a Microwave Marquis to keep order :crown: (court of cuisine?)
Sam: I nominate @Aj as Microwave Marquis. He's already earned the title after the day-1 microwave incident :popcorn:
Aj: I will accept the title if the crown is made of aluminum foil :sweat_smile:
OpsBot: reminder: office microwave is for hotdogs, leftovers, and the occasional awkward meal. Please clean spills. Incident report 23-11 filed.
Maya: also, can we start a tiny jar of 'fish soap' in kitchen? (obviously a joke) :soap:
Keelin: poll: Should we do a 5-min 'Microwave Etiquette Training' at next all-hands? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no, :laughing: if you want a duel.
Isla: I'm placing a 'NO FISH' sticker on the microwave tonight. Who's with me?
Sam: I'll help design the sticker. Suggestion: a little fish in a tiny lifeboat with 'Not Today' text.
Aj: fine, I'll stop nuking tuna at 3pm. Unless it's desperate times.
Maya: thanks team. Also, shoutout to Keelin for being our unofficial kitchen ambassador :heart:
Keelin: I'll accept the badge, but only if it's laminated and has adhesive backing.
Isla: legendary. New lore entry: "Microwave Marquis" established. Eng-rituals committee: please add to archives. :scroll:
Sam: can we get a ceremonial tiny crown for the microwave? low-cost and ceremonial.
Aj: will wear crown for photo. Someone make sure OpsBot doesn't try to file a dignity complaint. :robot_face:
Maya: note to future historians: there was once a Great Microwave Conspiracy. We survived. :sparkles:
